primary_ns: elapsed_ns: solve plus untouched original-ANF check, excluding evidence serialization
statistic: Median of seven paired comparator elapsed_ns / wide-metal elapsed_ns ratios
interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of paired-resampled medians; descriptive per-input intervals, not familywise guarantees
comparators: Every retained arm plus projection-cpu and wide-cpu. Identify fastest CPU by minimum median among actual CPU executions and fastest prior GPU by minimum median among actual GPU executions, independently for each input and trial.
repeat_gate: Two complete admitted trials for the panel, all samples within the frozen load gate, all reference/source/proof checks pass, actual wide-metal GPU execution, lower95 > 1 against every comparator in both trials. Preserve per-input failures and regressions; dispatch remains unchanged.
limits: Physical Apple M4 Pro, fixed planted PDP inputs only. No inference about natural relation yield, full IC/rho, other hardware or asymptotic complexity. No automatic promotion.
